decisions.reason: It is a differentiated analytics extension of the core tariff and pricing business, had a dedicated webpage, and fits the firm's platform strategy well enough to justify continued support.
The gas tariff comparison tool is very close to the firm's established utility-market services and remains commercially relevant as a clearly presented standalone offer.
This electricity tariff calculator sits squarely in the firm's core billing and tariff-calculation competence and is likely to stay as a standard platform component.
Although overlap with other tariff tools keeps withdrawal risk noticeable, its broader energy scope and multi-model line still make it worth retaining for now within the platform portfolio.

The site-specific comparison line has the strongest overlap with other comparison and calculator products, had weaker web prominence, and is the most likely candidate to be discontinued to free resources for core offerings and new development.
